perdŏlesco or -dŏlisco , lŭi, 3,
I.v. inch. n. [per-doleo], to feel great pain or grief: nec perdoliscit fligi socios, Att. ap. Non. 110, 31 (Trag. Rel. p. 150 Rib.): suam virtutem irrisui fore perdoluerunt, * Caes. B. C. 2, 15.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
